name: Dallas Love Field

runway.v: two runways on the current FAA diagram, 13R-31L and 13L-31R; sizes 8,800 x 150 ft (about 2,682 m) and 7,752 x 150 ft. The diagram text does not pair size with runway; the City's 2011 document ties 8,800 ft to 13R/31L

noise.v: voluntary noise programme: jets and aircraft over 12,500 lb prefer runway 13R/31L at night (21:00-06:00); engine maintenance run-ups banned midnight-06:00 and voluntarily avoided 22:00-midnight
noise.quote: All jet aircraft are preferred to operate on Runway 13R/31L at night.

customs.v: CBP office hours Monday to Friday 08:00-17:00 local (Central); CBP says arrival inspection is generally available 7 days a week, 24 hours, but weekend, holiday and after-hours arrivals must be arranged by 16:30 CST on the workday before; contact CBP at least 1 hour before leaving the foreign airport; aircraft taxi to the CBP inspection facility (not at an FBO); user fee airport
customs.quote: Monday through Friday, 8 am - 5 pm local time

handling.v: four full-service FBOs named by the airport: Signature Flight Support, Atlantic Aviation, Jet Aviation and Business Jet; their services include fuel
handling.quote: Four full service Fixed Based Operators (FBOs) at Love Field provide general aviation users with a wide scope of services.

curfew.v: voluntary noise curfew for scheduled airline flights 23:00-06:00 local (2006 agreement; Southwest agreed under its 2009 lease). The report says nothing about business or charter flights, so this is not a ban on them
curfew.quote: precluding scheduled airline flights between 11:00 pm and 6:00 am

missing: curfew (for business and charter flights; the recorded restraint covers scheduled airlines, from a 2021 audit)
